description: This file defines a React functional component 'ContextMenu' for rendering a context menu in a web application, along with related sub-components and context utilities. It manages state and effects for positioning and rendering a contextual menu with options related to notes and categories, utilizing Redux for state management and React portal for portal rendering.

classes.name: Position
classes.description: Interface defining the position with x and y coordinates for use within the context menu.

classes.name: ContextMenuProps
classes.description: Interface defining properties passed to the ContextMenu component, including the item to act on, its position, the ref to the menu element, a callback to set options ID, and the menu type.

classes.name: CategoryMenuProps
classes.description: Props for the CategoryMenu component, mainly the category item.

classes.name: NotesMenuProps
classes.description: Props for the NotesMenu component, including the note item and a callback to set options ID.

methods.name: ContextMenu
methods.description: Main React functional component rendering a context menu portal with positioning logic and conditional rendering based on context menu type.

methods.name: getOptionsYPosition
methods.description: Calculates Y position for the options menu to prevent overflow beyond the viewport.
